AutosarMessageSpecifics properties return incorrect values after initialization

#### Description

The AutosarMessageSpecifics class has incorrect default values and property implementations that cause several AUTOSAR-related properties to return wrong values. This affects message security status, network management flags, and end-to-end protection properties.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# Load an AUTOSAR database file
db = cantools.db.load_file('tests/files/arxml/system-4.2.arxml')

# Get a message that should have specific AUTOSAR properties
msg = db.get_message_by_name('Message3')

# Check security properties - should be True but returns False
print(f"Is secured: {msg.autosar.is_secured}")  # Expected: True, Actual: False

# Check network management flag
nm_msg = db.get_message_by_name('AlarmStatus') 
print(f"Is NM: {nm_msg.autosar.is_nm}")  # Expected: True, Actual: False

# Check end-to-end properties
msg1 = db.get_message_by_name('Message1')
print(f"E2E properties: {msg1.autosar.e2e}")  # Expected: E2E object, Actual: None
```

The properties return inverted or incorrect values due to faulty initialization and property getter logic in the AutosarMessageSpecifics class.
